Woke Horror Movies of 2025 Ranked: From Most to Least Ideological

The horror genre is Hollywood's most reliable ideological testing ground. This list ranks every 2025 horror and thriller in VirtueVigil's database, from the most ideologically loaded to the clearest choice for traditional viewers.

The horror genre is Hollywood's most reliable ideological testing ground. It normalizes transgressive themes under the cover of darkness and jump scares. In 2025, horror brought us films about trans identity horror, feminist body autonomy metaphors, and queer coming-of-age wrapped in genre packaging. This list ranks every 2025 horror and thriller in VirtueVigil's database, from the most ideologically loaded to the clearest choice for traditional viewers.

Rankings are sorted by net woke score (Woke Score minus Traditional Score), highest to lowest. Positive numbers indicate woke lean. Negative numbers indicate traditional lean.

#1 — Bugonia (2025)

STRONGLY WOKEWOKE: 28.94TRAD: 8.48NET: +20.46 WOKE

Genre: Horror • Platform: Streaming

The most ideologically loaded horror film of 2025 by net score. Bugonia uses genre mechanics as a delivery system for progressive themes around identity, bodily autonomy, and systemic power. Net woke plus 20.46. Not subtle about where it stands. The horror packaging is competent. The ideological content is the primary product.

Reading This List

The split in 2025 horror is stark. The top tier (Bugonia through G20) represents horror as ideological delivery system. These films use genre mechanics to normalize progressive themes and frame conservative values as the monster or the obstacle.

The bottom half (The Conjuring through The Accountant 2) represents something different: horror and thriller filmmaking where the genre's traditional strengths, confronting evil, protecting the innocent, sacrificing for others, are still allowed to function as intended. These are the films worth seeking out.
